(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Both are on file here, Shop···· and Shop····. The return is with the team for approval now, and they'll confirm it by email shortly. Nothing for you to send back until that lands.

Both units are logged as faulty against Shop···· and Shop····, with Hal's findings and your photos attached. The team is approving the return now, and the confirmation with the label comes to (email hidden) Worth checking spam, our mail has been landing there for some people.

Will do, Jeff. I'll keep it in front of the team and come back here the moment the return is approved, with the label and the return reference.

Nothing needed from you meanwhile. Leave both units unplugged and keep the boxes if you still have them, it makes the return easier.
